statement: Partition-key ordering has one complete owner: compareRoutingKeys supplies deterministic SQLite-BINARY-compatible TEXT/string order while preserving the already-landed numeric-vs-text-encoded-number order and typed mixed-space refusal; KeyRange, PartitionResolver, QueryGroup and split/merge adjacency consume that owner for partition keys, and no merge-adjacency raw relational partition-key comparator remains.

constraints.statement: Preserve the solved numeric-key-routing contract: a number against a text-encoded numeric partition boundary compares numerically, number/number remains numeric, and an unrelated mixed key space is refused rather than coerced.

The 0.3 persisted TEXT-key baseline is deterministic SQLite BINARY-compatible order, not host-locale collation. The implementation and behavioral witness must agree with the real SQLite ordering used to choose/order partition boundaries.

Merge adjacency, KeyRange, PartitionResolver and QueryGroup consume the same partition-key ordering owner. A table-id sort may use a separate stable identifier comparator but must not become or reuse a second partition-key semantic owner.

Do not absorb numeric precision, persisted type metadata, encoding migration or old-boundary revalidation into this Quest. Record any additional representation finding for planned Quest partition-key-boundary-representation.

This Quest changes no Raft runtime, consensus transport, replica lifecycle, membership or formation behavior. It may be developed while raft-rs-full-cutover finishes, but it is not merged to shared main ahead of that cutover's exact-head closeout.

Add deterministic behavioral witnesses for SQLite/BINARY string order and merge-adjacency owner consumption. Reverting each load-bearing semantic change must make the corresponding witness red; the structural doneWhen checker alone is not sufficient proof.

Any src/ change requires an independent verification newer than the last attempt. The verifier attacks duplicate comparison owners, coercion/locale dependence, hostile mixed input, and controlled-negative fidelity, with concrete evidence paths.

Capture relevant file-scoped complexity, literal/runtime-grammar and file-size status before production edits and finish with no increased guardrail debt; generated test metadata is refreshed through its producer, never edited by hand.
